project.name: Five-League Official Gamebook Mega Board
project.mission: One fast, accurate place for customer service agents to find game/team/player reference data and official league reports.
project.governance_policy: Explicit user decisions take precedence over older suggestions. For every Mega Board decision made with the assistant and every implementation/configuration change the assistant makes, update the canonical GitHub feature registry within the same task, recording intent, decision, actual status, evidence, and any relevant risks; have the readable register regenerated and verify success before reporting completion. Suggestions remain unapproved until the user accepts them. Independent external changes are discovered through GitHub monitoring and scheduled review, not assumed to be known immediately. Automated checks may report implementation drift but may not approve/reject ideas or restore removed features.

change_recording_policy.required_for: Every new decision, approval, rejection, deferral, requirement change, code/config/workflow change and completed project fix performed with the assistant
change_recording_policy.timing: During the same project task, before claiming completion
change_recording_policy.monitoring_limit: Outside edits or changes while no chat is active may require the scheduled checks/reviews to discover and reconcile; do not claim automatic instantaneous awareness.
change_recording_policy.authority: Only the user may approve, decline or re-prioritize suggested features.
change_recording_policy.premerge_delivery: For changes within the assistant's control, use a feature branch and pull request with successful pre-merge safety checks, then confirm production deployment and existing monitors. No skipping production checks or lowering alert frequency.

features.title: Single reliable agent-facing reference board
features.summary: Centralize accurate, detailed official game, player and team reference material for quick customer-service agent lookup; distinguish linked source reports from the summarized cards.
features.notes: The user explicitly said on 2026-11-23 that dedicated player-statistics features are not needed; exclude player-statistics search, tables, databases and analytics from future Mega Board recommendations. Existing league-provided gamebooks, reports and approved board behavior remain unchanged. IDEA-001 declined.

features.title: Five supported leagues
features.summary: NFL, NBA, WNBA, NHL and MLB feeds are combined on the Mega Board; WNBA lives in the basketball repository.

features.title: Independent league feeds and dashboards
features.summary: Keep the four league repos and their source feeds; the Mega Board integrates them. Existing standalone board pages may remain without equal UI enhancement effort.

features.title: Current-game vs archive search separation
features.summary: Current games and historical/retained archive have separate search and filters.

features.title: League sections and combined view
features.summary: Expandable/collapsed league sections with a combined all-leagues view.

features.title: Search by team, matchup, league, and game status
features.summary: Current-game search and team/league/status filters; archival league, team, year, status and matchup filtering.
features.notes: Normalization for alternate team spellings and abbreviations remains separately proposed (IDEA-002).

features.title: Rolling display periods
features.summary: NFL uses a weekly window; NBA, WNBA, NHL and MLB display yesterday/today/tomorrow, rotating at 3 AM America/New_York.

features.title: Archive disclosure with 200-result cap
features.summary: Archive collapsed by default, shows up to the 200 most recent matching games and expands upon league+team selection.
features.notes: Pagination beyond 200 was suggested but not approved.

features.title: Official report links by league
features.summary: NFL/NBA/WNBA official gamebook PDFs; NHL both GS and ES HTML reports; MLB official game-specific box score and play-by-play (not PDFs).

features.title: Truthful game and report status
features.summary: Show scheduled, live, finished awaiting report and report-available states without treating a finished game or guessed URL as a published document.

features.title: Automatic active-game monitoring
features.summary: Calendar-controlled adaptive/approximately five-minute game-time monitoring and reporting heartbeat; idle/offseason is not an error.

features.title: Page refresh and clock updates
features.summary: Mega Board refreshes displayed data periodically; manual refresh is available; clocks are separately updated.

features.title: Right-side instructions and feedback
features.summary: Published Help/How to Use area covering discovery, refresh, statuses, report latency, official sources and suggestions/feedback.
features.notes: The current sidebar still uses some older 'historical archive' wording; it should match forward-only retention. Tracked as RISK-003.

features.title: Protect archive on window rollover
features.summary: Archive eligible outgoing games before removing them from the rolling view; never overwrite a previously stored verified report just because a later poll is incomplete.

features.title: Archive integrity checks and safe publishing
features.summary: Fail on corrupt archive payloads/duplicate IDs; use atomic writes and regression gates. Forward-only retention is a scoped exception to original no-deletion behavior.

features.title: Independent current schedule missing-game audit
features.summary: Read-only current schedule comparisons including exact NFL matchups; discrepancies fail the audit instead of showing false green.
features.notes: Current scheduled game coverage continues; full historical coverage is intentionally paused.

features.title: Forward-only current and future collection
features.summary: Active archives contain complete reports only for games in the current reporting windows and newly completed games going forward; current scheduled/live games still display.
features.notes: Switched 2026-11-23; supersedes previous comprehensive historical archive plan.

features.title: Archive complete-data-only rule
features.summary: NFL/NBA/WNBA archived PDFs; NHL both GS+ES reports; MLB both game-specific report links backed by verified official API data. Incomplete games are not retained as complete archives.
features.notes: Important limitation: a report delayed beyond the current window may be missed (RISK-001).

features.title: Historical backfill suspended but recoverable
features.summary: Historical backfill workflows no longer run on a schedule. Manual jobs and code remain, guarded by an explicit ENABLE_HISTORICAL_BACKFILL opt-in.
features.notes: Requires deliberate policy changes before any future historical restoration.

features.title: Pre-cleanup branch backups
features.summary: Retain backup/pre-forward-only-2026-11-23 in all four source repositories; original historical data remains accessible through Git history.

features.title: Forward-only five-league safety check
features.summary: Read-only daily audit checks all five active archives for complete reports and verifies that historical backfill is guarded.

features.title: Document-level official source verification
features.summary: Incremental PDF/report/API validation, now scoped to current/new forward-only records, without rewriting the source archives.
features.notes: Document verification means PDF/game identity or official report type/MLB API data; not a guarantee that every statistic was independently audited.

features.title: Independent full 2026 schedule coverage checker
features.summary: Full-season read-only schedule audit was built and passed before forward-only cleanup; its historical workflow is now gated and unscheduled.

features.title: Simple diagnostics and honest health labels
features.summary: Differentiate a legitimately idle league, monitor check, missing-game discrepancy and pending report; do not claim unavailable sources are verified.

features.title: Preserve independent recovery and monitoring machinery
features.summary: Keep report recovery scripts, calendars, monitors, archive storage and tests so forward-only normal operation continues and historical recovery remains possible later.

features.title: Remove all NCAA boards and automation
features.summary: User explicitly requested complete removal of NCAA dashboards and associated pipelines, while preserving the five supported leagues.
features.notes: Do not reintroduce NCAA without a new explicit user decision.

features.title: Do not show a data-staleness monitor
features.summary: Visible data-age/staleness display and its separate monitoring feature were intentionally removed as unnecessary.
features.notes: Keep meaningful live monitoring and missing-game/report checks.

features.title: Do not run historical game backfills
features.summary: No continuing historical restoration or full past-season rebuilding. Keep code/backups for possible later reactivation.
features.notes: Supersedes the earlier 2025 and 2026 comprehensive coverage goals.

features.title: Do not retain historical unverified links
features.summary: Old or unverified historical game links and verification evidence were removed from active archives; do not reintroduce into active data.
features.notes: The backup branches retain previous history; this is not erasure of Git history.

features.title: No more 2025 season restoration
